asA: chain author or operator using rcf verify probes
iWant: deterministic catalog and agent screenshot probes to keep working as ad hoc runs
soThat: probes stay useful for exploration but never stand in for, or block, the release Verify
description: Catalog and agent modes are optional (change 4).
title: A chain author keeps the catalog and agent probes as optional ad hoc runs, never a precondition of release Verify

acceptanceCriteria.description: [happy] Given a fixture with rcf/verify-catalog.json and a local server, rcf verify run --url <server> --fbs FBS-001 --mode deterministic still runs as an ad hoc probe with its 0.36.x output and exit codes, and leaves every rcf/fbs/ file byte-identical.

[failure] Given --record with --mode deterministic or --mode agentScreenshotCritique, the verb exits 2 with "[error] usage release Verify runs the bound E2E tests; --mode probes are ad hoc only" and runs nothing.

[must-not] Release Verify never requires rcf/verify-catalog.json, an agent CLI or a probe on any criterion: the PASS fixture of the release story has neither a catalog nor any probe field and still records verified, and a spawn seam over that run records no agent CLI.
